description: This file defines the NormalizerService class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for normalizing data objects and arrays, utilizing traits for serialization logic. The class is part of the core service namespace and interacts with model classes and data, facilitating data normalization for the application.

classes.name: NormalizerService
classes.description: A service class responsible for normalizing data objects or arrays related to models within the OrangeHRM system using traits for the serialization process.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a single data object or value of a specified model class into an array format.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of data associated with a specific model class into an array format.
